# `tfctl profile display`

The `tfctl profile display` command displays the active profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile display
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile display` command displays the active profile configuration, including all set properties and their values, except for the configured API token. Refer to [/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile#available-properties](Available properties) for a list of the properties that can be configured for each profile.

## Available options

The `tfctl profile display` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following example demonstrates how to display the active profile.

### Display the active profile

The following example displays the active profile configuration, including all set properties and their values.

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile display
```
